notes: This is an unusually well-sourced dossier: every material rating-driving figure sampled (net debt, gross debt, EV bridge, ROIC, related-party borrowing, revenue growth, goodwill concentration, EPS-consensus cuts, peer margins, current price, minority interest, forward consensus revenue/EBITDA) traced to a literal, page-cited source in the data pool or recomputed exactly from disclosed components, several with independent multi-source cross-checks the modules performed themselves. The dossier's own pre-existing PROVISIONAL/UNVERIFIED banner (finish-gate output, committed at the top of final_thesis.md) claims the recorded scenario levels (CNY 31.78/23.67/16.79) disagree with an automated 'Playground' recompute (32.8139/24.7028/17.8162). Independent reproduction in this audit shows the banner's alternate figures arise only when minority interest (CNY 9,606.03mn) is dropped from the EV-to-equity bridge - i.e. they appear to come from a bug in the automated recompute tool, not a defect in the thesis, which correctly nets both net debt and minority interest per CLAUDE.md §16. This audit could not fully validate the finish-gate tool's internal logic (out of scope - it lives outside this run's artifacts), so this is reported as a strong but not absolute finding; a human should reconcile the finish-gate tool's bridge formula against valuation/01_price-and-capital-structure.md's documented one. The banner's other two flagged gaps (missing explicit per-scenario sign-check line in §5; empty joint_probability_basis for the 'base' and 'bear_cyclical' scenarios) were independently confirmed as real, unresolved, low/medium-severity documentation gaps - they do not change any number or the Watchlist rating, but a future run should close them. No critical or high-severity finding, no anchor conflict, and no confirmed math break were found; the headline Watchlist rating, its scenario math, and its cross-module anchors all stand up to independent recomputation. ciq_facts.json could not be generated in this environment (Python 3.9.6 lacks enum.StrEnum required by the tool's B3 generation hook) - noted as 'ciq_facts unavailable', not treated as a thesis defect.
